notes: A waltz-like tide in 3/4: up by step from the home note to the fifth, held across the bar, then down past the start to the leading note. Plain and singable; the held note is the high water. Summer: F major with the morning lift (a busier answer); the code-built piano leads, a warm string bed, vibraphone touches.
